name: Goldenrod Underground Tunnel & Rocket Cell
summary: Descend into the vibrant subterranean bazaar of the Goldenrod Underground Tunnel. Browse the Pokemon Hairdresser, the Weekend Bargain Shop, and the Bitter Herb Shop. Infiltrate the storage wing to bust a clandestine Team Rocket cell and report their contraband to the police for a +10 Karma boost.
